name: Armen Tamzarian
office: Associate Justice, Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four

items.text: Armen Tamzarian is an Associate Justice of the California Court of Appeal, Second District, Division Four, confirmed in 2025. He served as a Los Angeles Superior Court judge from 2013, handling civil and family law trials. Previously, he was a lead appellate court attorney and litigation partner. He authored an opinion upholding Los Angeles's Measure ULA transfer tax. He wrote an opinion limiting employer strict liability for supervisor harassment.
